items: 10 coins or a Ring of Charos (a)
rec: Teleport to Mort'ton, such as minigame teleport or Barrows Teleport
Silver sickle (b) to collect Mort Myre fungi (requires prayer points)

st.t: Talk to Vanstrom Klause in the Canifis pub.
s: Why do they need help? Are they in trouble?
Perhaps I could help you out here.

st.t: Fill a druid pouch with at least 5 Mort Myre items. Try to have more in case a ghast hits you.
Talk to Cyreg Paddlehorn by the boat on the east side of Mort'ton. Keep pushing him to take you across, then give him the planks.
s: Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.
Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons?
If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head!
What kind of a man are you to say that you don't care?
Here are some planks for you.
i: 10 coins or a Ring of Charos (a)

st.t: Board the swamp boaty in Mort'ton. If you forgot coins, you can obtain some by killing afflicted.
s: Yes. I'll pay the ten gold.
i: 10 coins or a Ring of Charos (a)

st.t: Climb the tree to the north of the boat.
Repair all 3 broken sections of the bridge as you cross it, using 1 plank and 75 steel nails on each.

Talk to Curpile Fyod and answer his questions. Only female member: Sani Piliu. Youngest member: Ivan Strom. Leader in Mort Myre: Veliaf Hurtz. Boatman: Cyreg Paddlehorn. Vampyre family that rules Morytania: Drakan. Originally a scholar: Polmafi Ferdygris. Check the spelling of each answer before you choose it.
s: I've come to help the Myreque. I've brought weapons.

st.t: Enter the wooden doors north of Curpile.
Follow the path north-west. Halfway up there's an alcove on the east side: tap the wall in its south-east corner to enter the hidden cave. Turn the camera if you can't see the entrance.
Talk to each of the members of the Myreque.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz again and give him the steel weapons. Be ready to fight the Skeleton Hellhound
Kill the Skeleton Hellhound. To safespot the hellhound using Magic, position it on the south side of the chair in the eastern part of the room.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz to learn the way out.
s: How do I get out of here?

st.t: Search the wall at the end of the tunnel to open it, then climb up the ladder in the north of the room.
Talk to the Stranger in the Canifis pub to finish the quest!

i: 10 coins or a Ring of Charos (a)
